lines.en: I trot over the grass.
My wings are half spread.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子落在土上没有重声
lines.en: My hooves land lightly.
I run with my head up.
My long horn points ahead.
I come down the slope.
I make a circuit of the plains.
I lift off a little and land again.

lines.zh: 风把我的鬃毛梳向后方
lines.en: The wind combs my mane back.
I walk steadily, step by step.
I patrol near my anchor.
I trot over toward you.

lines.zh: 我抬起前蹄再轻轻落下
lines.en: I lift a forehoof and set it down.
I turn, and my wings raise wind.
I stand with my wings folded.
The wind comes from behind me.
White light runs down my horn.
The wind carries grass from elsewhere.
I blow out a slow breath.
This patch of grass suits my hooves.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地看着前面
lines.en: I hold still and watch ahead.
I wait for you to speak first.
My tail sways lightly.
I crop a couple of mouthfuls.
I lift my head and shake my mane.
I will not fall.
Good wind here, just right.
The plain and the wind are mine.
You stand in my wing's shadow.
I lower my head to you.
I know a trainer's hands.
Are you getting on?
I lower my forelegs slowly.
Hold on to my mane.
My back is very steady.
You need not fear this height.
I lift my head and look at the sky.
I am waiting for one word.
I dip my horn toward you.

lines.zh: 你身上有风吹过的味道
lines.en: You smell of wind.
I fold my wings and step closer.
Wherever you go, I follow.
I rise, and my wings shift.
I will go along with you.
I shift back half a pace on four hooves.
My mane is pulled.
That blow left me numb.
I tuck my wings in.
My ears twitch.
I slowly settle onto my hooves.
My four hooves are still steady.
I will remember this wound.
My legs feel numb.
My wings still work.
I do not eat this sort of thing.

lines.zh: 你举着那玩意儿干什么
lines.en: What are you holding that thing up for?
I would rather have grass than this.

lines.zh: 这味道引不起我的胃口
lines.en: That smell stirs no appetite.
You can hold on to that.
I sniff it and turn away.
I am not very hungry.
Put it away first.

lines.zh: 我低头看你手里的东西
lines.en: I lower my head at what you hold.
I shake my head.
I nudge it with my nose.

lines.zh: 那玩意儿别在我眼前晃
lines.en: Do not wave that thing in front of me.
You ran right into my flank.
I did not sway at all.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀替你挡了一下
lines.en: My wing caught the blow for you.
Your foot is on my hoof.
I swing my wings aside to clear the way.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀顶到我的翼根
lines.en: Your shoulder jabs my wing joint.
One spread of my wings steadies me.
I back up half a pace on all four hooves.
Do not stand behind me.
I toss my mane.
I was raised for training.
I do not often think of such things.
Where my anchor is, I am.
That question need not be asked again.
I turn my head away.
I go back to the grass.
I can fly alone.
These plains are good.
I turn my face away.
I scrape the question aside with a hoof.
I pick it up and look.
I have never seen this.
I place it in your hand.
It is heavy; I can only drag it.
It fell from my mouth.
Whose is this? I keep it.
I sniff it; hardly any smell.
I set it on the grass.
Is this useful to you?
I nudge it with a hoof.
Something is coming close.
I turn square to it.
Both my wings are spread wide.
It has come into my sight.
Get under my wings.
My horn is aimed at it.
It is close enough to me now.
I lower my forequarters.
I must cover you.
I am about to use my light.
My forehooves have left the ground.
I beat my wings and charge.
I close in a small step at a time.
I hold the line between you and it.
My wings stay spread.
I watch which leg it moves first.
Each move of its, I mark.
It retreats; I will not chase far.
I am hunting its opening.
My horn stays pointed at it.
My head is held low.
It is inside my circle now.
I advance half a hoof.

lines.zh: 它要过去得先撞上我的角
lines.en: It must get past my horn first.
I lower my head and charge.
My single horn stabs into it.
My horn tosses it aside.
I lift off once and come down.

lines.zh: 我一扇翅膀掀起一阵风
lines.en: One beat of my wings raises a gust.
It slips off to the side.
I bring my hooves down.
That impact landed heavy.
I follow with a kick.
It falls back; I return to your front.
My mane scatters as I charge.
My four hooves are still under me.
The white light fades; I stand on grass.
My anchor has settled on these plains.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀迎着气流展开
lines.en: My wings open into the current.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候几乎没有声音
lines.en: I land almost silently.
I raise my head and see the plains.
My horn is bright in the sun.
Light still clings to my mane as I land.
The wind here is strong enough.
I chose a rise.
I take my place beside you.
I give a clear call.
I fold my wings slowly.
I flew here from far away.
I am waiting for you to mount.
Fire singes my mane.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，摔了一下
lines.en: I drop from a height and land hard.
Water forces its way into my nostrils.
The blast throws me onto the grass.
An arrow bites through my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 魔法把我的数据击散了
lines.en: Magic scatters my data.
I have not had grass in a long while.

lines.zh: 雷落在近旁，我一跳避开
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and I spring clear.
The ground under my hooves is gone.
